passages.title: 프린터 사용 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: IT Support
To: All Staff
Subject: New Printer

Hello everyone,

A new color printer has been installed on the second floor, next to the copy room. To use it, select 'Printer 2F' from your computer. Please print color pages only when necessary because color ink is expensive.

If you have any problems, call the IT help desk at extension 210.

Best regards,
IT Support Team

questions.q: What is the email mainly about?
questions.exKo: 새 컬러 프린터가 2층에 설치되었다는 안내가 핵심 내용입니다.

questions.q: Where is the new printer located?
questions.exKo: on the second floor, next to the copy room이라고 위치를 밝히고 있습니다.

questions.q: Why should staff limit color printing?
choices: The printer is shared with visitors
questions.exKo: because color ink is expensive라고 이유를 직접 언급합니다.

passages.title: 휴가 신청 마감 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Human Resources
To: All Employees
Subject: Summer Vacation Requests

Dear employees,

If you want to take vacation days in August, please send your request to your manager by July 15. Requests received after this date may not be approved because we need enough staff in the office.

You can check your remaining vacation days on the HR website.

Thank you,
HR Team

questions.q: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To announce a deadline for vacation requests
questions.exKo: 8월 휴가 신청을 7월 15일까지 제출하라는 마감 안내가 목적입니다.

questions.q: What should employees do by July 15?
choices: Send a request to their manager
questions.exKo: send your request to your manager by July 15에서 확인됩니다.

questions.q: Where can employees see their remaining vacation days?
questions.exKo: check your remaining vacation days on the HR website라고 안내합니다.

passages.title: 정수기 교체 작업 공지
passages.passage:
NOTICE

The water dispensers on all floors will be replaced with new models on Monday, March 4. The work will take place from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. During this time, bottled water will be available in the first-floor lobby.

The new dispensers provide both hot and cold water and are easier to clean.

We apologize for any inconvenience.

Building Management

questions.q: What will happen on March 4?
questions.exKo: 3월 4일에 전 층의 정수기가 새 모델로 교체된다는 공지입니다.

questions.q: What can people use during the work?
questions.exKo: 작업 중에는 1층 로비에 생수가 비치된다고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What is stated about the new dispensers?
choices: They provide hot and cold water
They require a card to use
They will be installed at night
questions.exKo: provide both hot and cold water and are easier to clean이라고 설명합니다.

passages.title: 사내 금연 구역 확대 공지
passages.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL STAFF

Starting next month, the smoking area behind Building B will be closed. Smoking will only be allowed in the designated area next to the parking garage. This change follows a survey in which most employees asked for cleaner outdoor spaces.

Signs will be posted this week. Thank you for your cooperation.

Facilities Office

questions.q: What is the notice about?
questions.exKo: B동 뒤 흡연 구역이 폐쇄되고 주차장 옆 지정 구역만 허용된다는 공지입니다.

questions.q: Why is the change being made?
choices: The city passed a new law
The area is needed for parking
questions.exKo: 설문에서 대부분의 직원이 더 깨끗한 야외 공간을 원했다고 이유를 밝힙니다.

questions.q: What will happen this week?
choices: The smoking area will move indoors
questions.exKo: Signs will be posted this week에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

passages.title: 문구점 신학기 세일 광고
passages.passage:
BACK-TO-SCHOOL SALE at PAPER PLUS!

From August 20 to August 31, get 20% off all notebooks, pens, and backpacks. Students with a school ID receive an extra 5% discount.

Visit our store at 88 Main Street, open daily from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. Free gift wrapping is available for purchases over $30.

Don't miss our biggest sale of the year!

questions.q: What is being advertised?
choices: A sale at a stationery store
questions.exKo: 문구점 Paper Plus의 신학기 세일을 홍보하는 광고입니다.

questions.q: Who can get an extra 5% discount?
questions.exKo: Students with a school ID receive an extra 5% discount라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What is offered for purchases over $30?
questions.exKo: Free gift wrapping is available for purchases over $30에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 세차 서비스 개업 광고
passages.passage:
GRAND OPENING — SHINY CAR WASH

Quick Auto Care opens its new car wash on Elm Road this Saturday! For the first week only, a basic wash costs just $5, half the regular price.

Our team cleans your car inside and out in under 20 minutes. Coffee is free while you wait.

Open seven days a week, 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. No reservation needed.

questions.q: What is the advertisement for?
questions.exKo: 새로 문을 여는 세차장 개업 광고입니다.

questions.q: How much is a basic wash during the first week?
questions.exKo: 첫 주에는 기본 세차가 정가의 절반인 5달러라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What is offered to waiting customers?
questions.exKo: Coffee is free while you wait에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

passages.title: 시립도서관 주말 개방 기사
passages.passage:
GREENFIELD — The city library will open on Sundays for the first time starting next month. The library used to close on weekends, but many residents asked for more open hours.

"Students and working people told us Sunday is the only day they can visit," said director Amy Lopez. Sunday hours will be from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. The change will be tested for six months.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
questions.exKo: 시립도서관이 다음 달부터 처음으로 일요일에 문을 연다는 기사입니다.

questions.q: Why is the library making the change?
choices: Residents asked for more open hours
The city passed a new law
questions.exKo: many residents asked for more open hours가 변경 이유입니다.

questions.q: How long will the change be tested?
questions.exKo: The change will be tested for six months라고 명시되어 있습니다.

passages.title: 지역 빵집 전국 대회 수상 기사
passages.passage:
RIVERTON — Local bakery Sweet Morning won first prize at the National Bread Festival last weekend. Owner Daniel Park entered his walnut sourdough, which judges called "simple but perfect."

The bakery opened five years ago near the train station. Since the award was announced, customers have lined up before the shop opens at 7 a.m. Park says he plans to hire two more bakers next month.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
choices: A bakery winning a national prize
questions.exKo: 지역 빵집이 전국 대회에서 1등을 했다는 소식이 기사의 핵심입니다.

questions.q: What did Daniel Park enter in the festival?
questions.exKo: entered his walnut sourdough에서 출품작을 알 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What does Park plan to do next month?
questions.exKo: plans to hire two more bakers next month라고 밝혔습니다.

passages.title: 회의실 예약 부탁 문자
passages.passage:
Mia Chen (2:14 P.M.)
Hi Tom, are you at your desk?

Tom Reed (2:15 P.M.)
Yes, what's up?

Mia Chen (2:15 P.M.)
Could you book Meeting Room A for 4 o'clock? My computer just froze, and the client call starts soon.

Tom Reed (2:16 P.M.)
Sure. For how many people?

Mia Chen (2:17 P.M.)
Five. Thanks so much! I owe you a coffee.

Tom Reed (2:18 P.M.)
Done. The room is booked from 4 to 5.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Chen contact Mr. Reed?
choices: To ask him to book a meeting room
To invite him to a client call
questions.exKo: 컴퓨터가 멈춰서 4시 회의실 예약을 대신 부탁하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What problem does Ms. Chen have?
questions.exKo: My computer just froze라고 문제를 설명합니다.

questions.q: What does Mr. Reed confirm at 2:18 P.M.?
questions.exKo: Done. The room is booked from 4 to 5로 예약 완료를 알립니다.

passages.title: 출근길 지연 보고 문자
passages.passage:
Alex Kim (8:32 A.M.)
Good morning, Ms. Diaz. My bus broke down on the highway. I'll be about 30 minutes late.

Rosa Diaz (8:33 A.M.)
Thanks for letting me know. Are you okay?

Alex Kim (8:34 A.M.)
Yes, another bus is coming to pick us up.

Rosa Diaz (8:35 A.M.)
Good. Your 9 o'clock meeting with the design team — I'll move it to 10.

Alex Kim (8:36 A.M.)
That would be great. Thank you!

questions.q: Why does Mr. Kim send the message?
choices: To report that he will be late
To ask for a day off
questions.exKo: 버스 고장으로 30분 정도 늦는다는 것을 알리기 위한 메시지입니다.

questions.q: What happened to Mr. Kim?
questions.exKo: My bus broke down on the highway에서 확인됩니다.

questions.q: What will Ms. Diaz do?
choices: Send a car for Mr. Kim
questions.exKo: 9시 디자인팀 회의를 10시로 옮기겠다고 말합니다.
